title: Line-Following Robot with PID Tuning Experiments
description: Builds a small wheeled robot that follows a line, tunes proportional, integral and derivative terms in a documented sequence and plots how each setting changes speed and wobble on the same track.

title: Obstacle-Avoiding Robot with a State Machine
description: Combines distance sensing and simple rules in a clear state machine so a robot explores a room without getting stuck, with a log of every situation where it failed. Includes a state diagram and a table of failure cases.

title: ROS 2 Navigation Stack on a Simulated Warehouse
description: Configures mapping and path planning for a simulated wheeled robot, tests it in a cluttered warehouse model and reports success rate, path length and recovery behaviours.

title: Sumo Robot Strategy Comparison with Match Simulation
description: Simulates matches between different search and attack strategies, ranks them by win rate with confidence intervals and tests the winner on a physical robot in the ring. Includes a record of where simulation and reality disagreed.

title: Swarm Robot Coverage Simulation
description: Simulates many simple robots covering an area using local rules only, measures time to full coverage for different rules and group sizes and tests resilience when some robots fail.

title: Pick-and-Place Cell Planner with Collision Checking
description: Plans arm motions between pick and place points in a simulated work cell, checks for collisions with fixtures and compares planners on success rate and motion time. Includes a table of failed plans and their causes.
